name: Backbeat
lore: A forgotten marching drum with a heartbeat loud enough to wake a realm.

primary.name: Sound Wave
primary.description: An expanding sound ring deals 14 damage once and slows enemies by 25% for 1.6 seconds.

secondary.name: Triple Tempo
secondary.description: Three expanding pulses deal 8 damage each and erase hostile projectiles. An enemy hit by all three pulses from this cast burns for 3 damage per second for 3 seconds.

special.name: Big Bang
special.description: A huge sound ring deals 45 damage and stuns struck enemies for 2 seconds.

passive: Drums of War: you and nearby allies deal 8% more damage within your 200-unit aura.

technique.name: Faraway Rhythm
technique.description: Sound Wave reaches 40% farther, for 25% less damage; its slow remains.

final_technique.name: Thunder Roll
final_technique.description: Send a charged directional thunder lane for 75 damage and 1s stun. Trades the all-around Big Bang for reach and a narrower target area.

attack.name: Thunder Roll
attack.description: Send a charged directional thunder lane for 75 damage and 1s stun. Trades the all-around Big Bang for reach and a narrower target area.
